messages.text: 'A huge milestone' - Kartal becomes second Brit ever to reach WTA 1000 final

metadata.summary: Britain's Sonay Kartal was forced to dig deep to beat Jelena Ostapenko and secure a spot in her first-ever WTA 1000 final on Saturday.
metadata.content: Sonay Kartal: British star digs deep to beat Jelena Ostapenko and secure a spot in her first-ever WTA 1000 final | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Sonay Kartal: British star digs deep to beat Jelena Ostapenko and secure a spot in her first-ever WTA 1000 final Sonay Kartal defeats Jelena Ostapenko to reach her first-ever WTA 1000 final against French Open finalist Maja Chwalinska; You can watch the WTA Wuhan Open final - live on Sky Sports on Sunday from 11.30am Raz Mirza Sports Journalist @RazMirza Saturday 17 October 2026 15:02, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Wuhan Open semi-final between Sonay Kartal and Jelena Ostapenko Britain's Sonay Kartal was forced to dig deep to beat Jelena Ostapenko and secure a spot in her first-ever WTA 1000 final on Saturday. Kartal became only the second British woman, after Johanna Konta (Beijing 2016, Miami 2017, Rome 2019), to reach a WTA 1000 final with a stunning 7-6 (11-9) 7-6 (7-5) victory over Ostapenko. Currently 170th in the WTA rankings, Kartal will break inside the top 50 and become the new British No 1 after becoming the lowest-ranked player to reach the final in Wuhan. The 24-year-old, playing in only her third tournament since returning from a back injury, saved multiple set points to punish Ostapenko, despite the Latvian hitting an astonishing 50 winners in the match.
